title: Adventure Time: Side Quests Is a Pitch-Perfect Revival for the Cartoon Network Classic (Review)
content: Adventure Time has returned for a brand new series going all the way back to the original spirit of the show, and it’s a pitch perfect revival of the Cartoon Network classic. You might have noticed lately how there have been a lot of new franchise revivals with Cartoon Network of the last few years.

title: Singapore Studio Kasagi Labo Announces New Ninja Scroll Project
content: Yoshiaki Kawajiri not only directed the Ninja Scroll film at the Studio Madhouse , but he also wrote the screenplay and designed the characters. The film opened in Japan in 1993 and later became a popular showing on American cable television. Sentai Filmworks licensed the film in in 2012.

title: Classroom of the Elite Season 5 Announced
content: Classroom of the Elite Season 5 was officially announced immediately after the fourth season’s finale premiered. The first 4 episodes released all at once, making for a 90-minute special premiere of the new season. It ran for a total of 16 episodes.

title: The One Piece Anime Remake's 1st Teaser Trailer Reveals Mayumi Tanaka's Reprisal as Luffy
content: Netflix unveiled during this year's Annecy International Film Festival on Wednesday the first teaser trailer for The One Piece , Wit Studio 's remake of the One Piece anime for the streaming service, and it reveals that Mayumi Tanaka will reprise her role as Monkey D. Luffy.
